meta.title: AI + Java Dev Cockpit
meta.subtitle: Visual references for a dense, clear, IDE-like product frontend.
meta.business: AI + Java development coach and Agent workspace
meta.goal: Turn a runnable MVP into a daily-use product frontend for Java AI learning, Agent/RAG debugging, and engineering review.

signals.label: Audience
signals.value: University students, Java AI learners, and developers debugging Agent/RAG workflows.

signals.label: Tone
signals.value: Dense, clear, calm engineering cockpit with IDE and console cues.

signals.label: Scope
signals.value: Navigation, workspace shell, visual tokens, Dev Coach core page, login, component polish.

signals.label: Avoid
signals.value: Generic purple AI gradients, marketing hero pages, readable fake UI text, logos, collage tiles, stock-photo cliches.

items.title: Midnight IDE Cockpit
items.caption: A calm workstation atmosphere for the primary app shell: sidebar, command surface, status rails, and deep focus.
items.motif: IDE workspace, terminal glow, dense panels, keyboard-level productivity
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a modern software developer workstation at night, one large IDE-like interface reflected on a dark glass desk, dense but clean panels, subtle cyan and green status lights, matte black keyboard, no readable text, no logos, no split panels, no collage, cinematic but restrained, crisp product-design lighting.

items.title: Clean RAG Debug Table
items.caption: Reference for RAG evidence review: structured rows, retrieval traces, source cards, and readable density.
items.motif: retrieval table, evidence lanes, subtle highlights, inspection mode
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a clean high-density AI retrieval debugging surface on a laptop screen, structured table rows and source preview zones suggested as abstract blocks without readable text, light neutral background, precise blue and amber accents, no logos, no readable UI labels, no collage, one composed scene.

items.title: Agent Tool Trace Map

items.prompt: Single visual reference image of an abstract agent execution flow displayed on a dark engineering monitor, compact nodes and connecting lines representing tool calls and results, subtle green success and blue reasoning accents, no readable text, no logos, no diagram labels, no collage, one cohesive screen-like scene.
